notes.title: A Nice Tune For Your Adventures – Soundtrack DLC Release Planned for 30th of Sep
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello, adventurers![/b][/p][p]First, I want to sincerely apologize for the lack of updates since the last patch in June. However, I've been working on a massive update that's to be released 1st of January.[/p][p][/p][p]And yes, we finally have our very own Soundtrack! Composed, Played, and Edited/Refined by SilverDam DJ. The soundtrack will be released on the 30th of this very September, and will be containing every background music used in the game by SilverDam DJ.
[/p][p]For transparency, 25% of the soundtrack revenue goes to our DJ whom chose to be called SilverDam DJ. To clarify, 30% of all revenue goes to Steam, and another 30% goes to the IRS as US Taxes. Then 40% remain (if there are no additional withholding taxes), and I'm giving 25% from that 40 to SilverDam DJ, so that leaves me with 15% to keep some for myself and spend some on game development.[/p][p]
Stay tuned for more updates, and looking forward to hearing your thoughts.[/p]

notes.title: An Honest Update from the Developer
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I want to take a moment to be completely honest with you all. As the sole developer of [b]World of Islands[/b] and the co-developer of [b]Deadly Night - No Escape[/b], I’ve poured my heart into these projects since I was 17. Game development has always been my passion, and I’ve done everything I could to bring these games to life with the limited skills I have.

However, life hasn’t been easy. Over the past months (or years), I’ve struggled with depression and personal challenges that have made it incredibly difficult to stay motivated and keep working at the pace I once did. I never intended to abandon World of Islands or Deadly Night - No Escape. The vision for both games is clear, and there’s so much planned, so much passion behind them. But without the motivation to move forward, everything has felt like it’s collapsing.

For Deadly Night - No Escape, I have a friend working alongside me, but we’ve always been like a right and left arm, one can’t function properly without the other. Because of my struggles, development on that project has stalled as well.

That said, I haven’t completely stepped away. I recently finished writing World of Islands’ full story and included it as a free novel with the Early Access version. Unfortunately, I’ve received reports that some players are unable to find or download it, and I’ll do my best to fix that as soon as possible.

To everyone who has supported these games, waited for updates, and believed in what I’m building, I’m truly sorry for letting you down. I deeply appreciate your patience and understanding. I don’t know when I’ll be able to fully return to development, but please know that I still care about these games and the people who enjoy them.

Thank you for sticking with me.

notes.title: The Journey Continues – Free Novel eBook DLC & Game Development Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, adventurers![/b]

First, I want to sincerely apologize for the lack of updates since September 2019. I know it's been a long wait, and I truly appreciate your patience and support. But I want to reassure you that I never abandoned World of Islands.

For the past few years, I’ve been writing the novel that serves as the foundation for the game’s world, lore, and characters. Now that the novel is complete, I can finally return to game development and bring this story to life in its interactive form.

To celebrate this milestone and as a token of appreciation, I will be releasing the World of Islands novel as a free DLC, but only during Early Access. This will give players an even deeper dive into the world and history of the islands.

From this point forward, development will resume actively, and I will be sharing updates, improvements, and insights as we move closer to the full release. Thank you for sticking with me on this journey. I’m excited to bring you the adventure you’ve been waiting for!

Stay tuned for more updates, and looking forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.title: Game Upgrade
notes.notes:
Greetings to all WOITH awesome players,

We are changing the game [u] entirely [/u] except the story will remain almost the same. We are doing this because the game engine "RPG Maker 2003" doesn't meet our needs to create a good game with a creative story and gameplay. This process will not take longer than 3 months, and with it comes the new map too [spoiler] where you starting to face enemy bosses other than the Dark Lord [/spoiler]. Additionally, we are going to add a Multiplayer BETA (PVP & Co-op).

Thank you for buying and playing WOITH.

[h1]NOTE: This game will never be dead!!! We will be always up to date.[/h1]

Best Regards
SilverDam™
